Needed: A sheet of glass or acrylic the size of the top for Gaming coffee table shell
Kind of part: Any item

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["cracked", "chipped", "broken", "scratched", "frame only no glass", "table base only", "wood top"], "pattern": "(glass|acrylic).{0,20}(gaming|coffee).{0,20}table.{0,20}top", "phrasings": [{"text": "gaming coffee table glass top", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=gaming+coffee+table+glass+top", "why": "Finds listings that specifically mention gaming tables where generic coffee table glass searches miss."}, {"text": "coffee table replacement glass", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=coffee+table+replacement+glass", "why": "Finds sellers listing it as a replacement part without saying gaming."}, {"text": "glass table top sheet", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=glass+table+top+sheet", "why": "Finds plain glass sheets sold by size for table tops."}, {"text": "acrylic sheet for coffee table", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=acrylic+sheet+for+coffee+table", "why": "Finds acrylic plastic alternative when sellers never use the word glass."}, {"text": "gaming table glass panel", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=gaming+table+glass+panel", "why": "Finds sellers who call it a panel instead of a top or sheet."}]}
